name: 11ai-core-skills
description: Skills for building, auditing, and maintaining other skills and the plugins that package them, plus general-purpose guidance-compression and repository reverse-engineering utilities.

interface.shortDescription: Build, audit, and maintain other skills.
interface.longDescription: Skills whose subject is skills: authoring a new one, auditing frontmatter and packaging across harnesses, wiring a plugin into the marketplace and catalogs, and keeping counts, manifests, and cross-skill copies in sync as the collection grows. Also includes two general-purpose utilities: compressing guidance text and reverse engineering an existing repository.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me use the 11ai-core-skills skills to author or audit a skill in this collection.
